items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I was playing second, and they brought Babe in, and Babe was playing in there, and we used to swap the -- you know, concerts.

ctx.x: Yeah, and Babe -- Babe from Baltimore. Babe -- uh, it's a heck of a -- another heck of a trumpet player. I forgot Babe's name, but that was a band.
Were you playing first trumpet with the band?
